title: Saving window settings
description:
Save and load tool settings in an ini-style file, as `imgui.ini` does.

```
[Window][Inspector]
Pos=20,40
Size=300,500
Collapsed=0

[Window][Log]
Pos=340,40
...
loaded 2 windows; unknown keys kept as they were
```
hints: Keep sections in a vector to remember their order; a line starting with `[` starts a new one (lesson 4.06).
requirements: Read sections `[Type][Name]` and `key=value` lines into a map of maps.
Write them back in the same order; keep keys you do not understand.
Parse `Pos` and `Size` into two numbers each, refusing bad values (use defaults then).
stretch: Add your own section type (`[Tool][Grid]`), as ImGui's settings handlers let you.
